study type: Retrospective cohort for prediction model development
exposure: Medical codes from electronic health records (EHR)
cohort: The study utilized a large cohort of 222,436 deliveries from electronic health records to develop and test a preterm birth prediction model.
finding: The PredictPTB model predicted preterm birth with ROC-AUCs of 0.82, 0.79, and 0.78 at 1, 3, and 6 months prior to delivery, respectively, and found that observational data modalities like diagnoses were more predictive than interventional data modalities.
cross-section timing: Predictions were made at 1, 3, 6, and 9 months prior to delivery using longitudinal EHR data.
